_meta.what: The last three days of each city's AQI in CPCB's daily bulletin.
_meta.source: Central Pollution Control Board daily AQI bulletins (cpcb.gov.in), parsed into data/raw/cpcb-bulletins-2026.csv.gz.
_meta.scale: CPCB AQI: Good 0-50, Satisfactory 51-100, Moderate 101-200, Poor 201-300, Very Poor 301-400, Severe 401+. Not the US AQI that WAQI reports.
_meta.note: A city-wide daily figure, published about a day late. Never present it as a live reading.
